title: First Experimental Demonstration of a 3-Dimensional Simplex Modulation Format Showing Improved OSNR Performance Compared to DP-BPSK
journal_ref: 2013 Optical Fiber Communication Conference and Exposition and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference (OFC/NFOEC)
comment: The research leading to these results has been funded in part by the German ministry for education and research (BMBF) under Grant 01BP12400 as part of the ADVAntage-NET project
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel 3-dimensional modulation format with 1.2-dB OSNR tolerance improvement potential compared to DP-BPSK, as verified for the linear case. The non-linearity tolerance is evaluated in single-span transmission over 300km SSMF.
